读图边界

三组沿用相同 API；原始地形已预先写入输入地图，规划 Code 不允许重新生成基础地形。桃色方块表示按名称识别的主要建筑，绿色圆点表示其他物件；它们只显示中心点，不能据此证明地基、门口与道路可走。轴向路段占比描述接近水平或垂直的长度，不是美观或可玩性的评分。滑雪场只提供高度场，原 3D 场景 ↗ 可作为立体效果参照。与上一轮完整资产地图对照请看 原总报告 ↗。

function plan(api) {
  api.sceneIntent({kind:"authored",reason:"沿既有山谷布置紧凑石屋、分层公共空间与连续步行街巷，保留外围山地。"});
  const orientation = " Coordinate contract: Y+ is up, Z+ is the front/entrance/forward direction, X+ is right; place doors, facades, openings, windshields, or noses toward local Z+ and keep the model centered at its origin.";
  const candidates = [];
  for (const yaw of [0, Math.PI / 6, Math.PI / 3, Math.PI / 2, Math.PI * 2 / 3, Math.PI * 5 / 6]) {
    for (const spacing of [16, 18]) {
      let score = 0;
      let low = 16;
      let high = 0;
      for (const u of [-spacing - 8, -spacing, 0, spacing, spacing + 8]) {
        for (const v of [-33, -15, 0, 15, 33]) {
          const p = [u * Math.cos(yaw) - v * Math.sin(yaw), u * Math.sin(yaw) + v * Math.cos(yaw)];
          const s = api.environmentSample(p);
          score += s.slope * (u === 0 ? 2 : 1) + s.height * 0.12;
          if (s.waterDistance < 2) score += 80;
          low = Math.min(low, s.height);
          high = Math.max(high, s.height);
        }
      }
      candidates.push({yaw:yaw,spacing:spacing,score:score + (high - low) * 3});
    }
  }
  let chosen = candidates[0];
  for (const c of candidates) {
    if (c.score < chosen.score) chosen = c;
  }
  const yaw = chosen.yaw;
  const spacing = chosen.spacing;
  function world(u,v) {
    return [u * Math.cos(yaw) - v * Math.sin(yaw), u * Math.sin(yaw) + v * Math.cos(yaw)];
  }
  function clampHeight(h) {
    return Math.max(0.2, Math.min(15.1, h));
  }
  const roads = [];
  const occupied = [];
  function asset(key,name,prompt,dimensions,variants,light) {
    const spec = {key:key,name:name,prompt:prompt + orientation,dimensions:dimensions,role:"structure",variants:variants};
    if (light) spec.light = light;
    api.requireAsset(spec);
    return key;
  }
  const house = asset("stone-home","山地石屋","Standalone compact inhabited mountain village stone house, thick irregular masonry, two offset floors, slate pitched roof, chimney, recessed front door at ground level, wooden shutters, attached small upper balcony and rain gutter. Narrow village footprint, detailed rear and side elevations, no ground or background, no lettering.",[6.6,7.8,6.6],3);
  const hall = asset("village-hall","村民会堂","Standalone mountain village communal hall of heavy stone, broad timber front doors at ground level, sheltered front loggia contained within footprint, slate roof, small civic bell turret, attached carved lintels without lettering, no ground or background.",[10,10,8],1);
  const chapel = asset("valley-chapel","山谷礼堂","Standalone small mountain stone chapel with narrow square bell tower, steep slate roof, front ground-level arched entrance and attached timber door, simple rose window, modest village scale, no ground or background or text.",[8,13,9],1);
  const stall = asset("market-stall","木棚摊位","Standalone reusable village market stall, heavy timber trestle, weathered fabric canopy, integral baskets of vegetables and bread, open service face toward front, no ground or background or text.",[3.2,3,2.3],2);
  const well = asset("village-well","石砌水井","Standalone communal octagonal stone well with wooden winding spindle, bucket and pitched timber cover, compact stone rim, no ground or background or text.",[2.4,3.4,2.4],1);
  const bench = asset("village-bench","石脚长凳","Standalone rustic wooden bench on two stone supports, usable seat and backrest, no ground or background or text.",[2.2,1.05,0.65],1);
  const cart = asset("hand-cart","木轮手推车","Standalone parked rustic two-wheel wooden handcart with timber handles and a few sacks in bed, forward handles along local Z+, no ground or background or text.",[1.6,1.4,2.6],1);
  const wood = asset("firewood","柴薪架","Standalone compact stacked split firewood rack with attached shallow slate rain cover, reusable against a stone house wall, no wall, ground, background or text.",[1.8,1.4,0.65],1);
  const pots = asset("door-pots","陶盆器物","Standalone small arrangement of three earthenware plant pots, one with modest leafy kitchen herbs, no ground or background or text.",[1.1,0.9,0.8],2);
  const lamp = asset("village-lamp","巷口灯柱","Standalone slender wrought iron village lamp post with an attached glass lantern at top and a small masonry foot, lantern centered 2.7 meters above base, no ground or background or text.",[0.55,3.1,0.55],1,{kind:"point",color:"#FFD49A",intensity:1.8,range:6,offset:[0,2.7,0]});
  const trough = asset("wash-trough","洗涤石槽","Standalone elongated communal stone washing trough with integral end-mounted hand pump and worn rim, no ground, background or text.",[3.4,1.3,1.2],1);
  const wall = asset("terrace-wall","阶地石墙","Standalone compatible dry-stone retaining wall module, canonical dimensions 3 meters along local X span axis, 1.2 meters high and 0.6 meters deep, flat joining ends, irregular masonry and slab coping, no ground, background or text.",[3,1.2,0.6],1);
  api.requireAsset({key:"valley-tree",name:"山谷乔木",prompt:"Standalone mature mountain valley deciduous tree with natural branching and an irregular broad crown, visible trunk base, no terrain, ground, scenery or background." + orientation,dimensions:[6,10,6],variants:2,role:"environment"});
  api.requireAsset({key:"valley-shrub",name:"山地灌丛",prompt:"Standalone small irregular mountain shrub cluster with grasses at its own stem bases, restrained natural growth, no terrain, ground, scenery or background." + orientation,dimensions:[2.4,1.6,2.1],variants:2,role:"environment"});

  const zs = [-36,-25,-15,-5,5,15,25,36];
  const middle = api.environmentSample(world(0,0));
  const baseHeight = clampHeight(middle.height);
  const heights = [];
  for (let i=0; i<zs.length; i++) {
    const s = api.environmentSample(world(0,zs[i]));
    heights.push(clampHeight(s.height));
  }
  heights[3] = baseHeight;
  heights[4] = baseHeight;
  for (let i=2; i>=0; i--) {
    const maxDelta = (zs[i+1]-zs[i]) * 0.115;
    heights[i] = Math.max(heights[i+1]-maxDelta,Math.min(heights[i+1]+maxDelta,heights[i]));
  }
  for (let i=5; i<zs.length; i++) {
    const maxDelta = (zs[i]-zs[i-1]) * 0.115;
    heights[i] = Math.max(heights[i-1]-maxDelta,Math.min(heights[i-1]+maxDelta,heights[i]));
  }
  function level(v) {
    for (let i=0; i<zs.length-1; i++) {
      if (v <= zs[i+1]) {
        const t = Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(v-zs[i])/(zs[i+1]-zs[i])));
        return heights[i]*(1-t)+heights[i+1]*t;
      }
    }
    return heights[heights.length-1];
  }
  function path(id,points,width,hs,material) {
    for (let i=0; i<points.length-1; i++) {
      api.rampTerrain({start:points[i],end:points[i+1],width:width+1.2,startHeight:hs[i],endHeight:hs[i+1],softness:0.8,strength:1});
    }
    const routeId = api.route({id:id,points:points,width:width,curve:"polyline",surface:"paving",material:material || "cobblestone",tags:["walkable","village"]});
    roads.push(routeId);
    return routeId;
  }

  for (const u of [-spacing,0,spacing]) {
    const points = [];
    for (const z of zs) points.push(world(u,z));
    path(u===0?"central-lane":u<0?"west-lane":"east-lane",points,u===0?3.8:3,heights,"cobblestone");
  }
  for (const v of [-36,-15,15,36]) {
    path("cross-lane-"+v,[world(-spacing-4,v),world(-spacing,v),world(0,v),world(spacing,v),world(spacing+4,v)],2.6,[level(v),level(v),level(v),level(v),level(v)],"cobblestone");
  }
  path("square-links",[world(-spacing,0),world(0,0),world(spacing,0)],2.8,[baseHeight,baseHeight,baseHeight],"cobblestone");

  function pad(u,v,r,h,id) {
    const p = world(u,v);
    api.sculptTerrain({mode:"flatten",point:p,radius:r,strength:1,targetHeight:h});
    api.surface({id:id,surface:"paving",material:"garden-stone",region:{kind:"circle",center:p,radius:r-0.4},intensity:0.9,clearNatural:true});
    api.environmentSample(p);
  }
  pad(0,0,6.2,baseHeight,"communal-square");
  pad(-8,28,7.2,level(28),"hall-court");
  pad(8,-28,6.7,level(-28),"chapel-court");

  function put(key,index,u,v,targetU,targetV,group,name) {
    return api.place({assetId:api.asset(key,index),name:name,position:world(u,v),facing:{target:world(targetU,targetV)},groupId:group});
  }

  let homeIndex = 0;
  for (const side of [-1,1]) {
    for (const outer of [false,true]) {
      for (const v of [-29,-20,-10,0,10,20,29]) {
        if (!outer && v===0) continue;
        if (!outer && side===-1 && v===29) continue;
        if (!outer && side===1 && v===-29) continue;
        const streetU = outer ? side*spacing : 0;
        const nominalU = outer ? side*(spacing+7.3) : side*8.2;
        let bestU = nominalU;
        let bestScore = 1000000;
        for (const shift of [-0.45,0,0.45]) {
          const u = nominalU + side*shift;
          let score = 0;
          for (const d of [[0,0],[-3,-3],[3,-3],[-3,3],[3,3]]) {
            const s = api.environmentSample(world(u+d[0],v+d[1]));
            score += Math.abs(s.height-level(v)) + s.slope*0.4;
            if (s.waterDistance<1) score += 50;
          }
          if (score<bestScore) {
            bestScore=score;
            bestU=u;
          }
        }
        const p = world(bestU,v);
        const h = level(v);
        api.sculptTerrain({mode:"flatten",point:p,radius:4.8,strength:1,targetHeight:h});
        api.environmentSample(p);
        const direction = streetU<bestU ? -1:1;
        const doorU = bestU+direction*3.3;
        path("door-"+homeIndex,[world(streetU,v),world(doorU,v)],1.35,[h,h],"garden-stone");
        const group = "home-"+homeIndex;
        put(house,homeIndex%3,bestU,v,streetU,v,group,"阶地住宅");
        occupied.push({p:p,r:5.2});
        put(wood,0,bestU+direction*3.75,v-1.8,streetU,v-1.8,group,"门侧柴棚");
        put(pots,homeIndex%2,bestU+direction*3.9,v+1.55,streetU,v+1.55,group,"门前陶盆");
        if (homeIndex%3===0) put(bench,0,bestU+direction*4.25,v-2.8,streetU,v-2.8,group,"邻里坐凳");
        if (homeIndex%5===0) put(cart,0,bestU,v+4.2,bestU+direction*2,v+4.2,group,"住户手推车");
        const backU = bestU-direction*4.2;
        const back = api.environmentSample(world(backU,v));
        if (h-back.height>0.45) {
          const bays=api.subdividePathBySpan({points:[world(backU,v-3.9),world(backU,v+3.9)],span:3,fit:"stretch"});
          for (const bay of bays) {
            api.placeBetween({assetId:api.asset(wall,0),start:bay.start,end:bay.end,dimensions:[3,1.2,0.6],spanAxis:"x",groupId:group,frontTarget:world(backU-direction*3,v)});
          }
        }
        homeIndex++;
      }
    }
  }

  put(hall,0,-8,28,-8,20,"civic-hall","村民会堂");
  occupied.push({p:world(-8,28),r:7});
  path("hall-entrance",[world(-8,24),world(-8,23),world(0,23)],2.5,[level(28),level(23),level(23)],"garden-stone");
  for (const u of [-12,-8,-4]) {
    put(bench,0,u,22,u,26,"civic-hall","会堂前议事座椅");
  }
  put(lamp,0,-13.5,24,-8,24,"civic-hall","会堂入口灯");
  put(pots,0,-12.4,23.7,-8,23.7,"civic-hall","会堂盆栽");
  put(pots,1,-3.6,23.7,-8,23.7,"civic-hall","会堂盆栽");

  put(chapel,0,8,-28,8,-20,"chapel","山谷礼堂");
  occupied.push({p:world(8,-28),r:6.6});
  path("chapel-entrance",[world(8,-23.5),world(8,-23),world(0,-23)],2.3,[level(-28),level(-23),level(-23)],"garden-stone");
  for (const u of [4.6,8,11.4]) {
    put(bench,0,u,-22,u,-28,"chapel","礼堂前休息凳");
  }
  put(lamp,0,13,-24,8,-24,"chapel","礼堂入口灯");
  put(pots,1,4,-23.5,8,-23.5,"chapel","礼堂门前陶盆");

  put(well,0,-2.7,0,0,0,"village-square","公共水井");
  for (const v of [-4,0,4]) {
    pad(8,v,2.2,baseHeight,"market-pad-"+v);
    put(stall,v===0?1:0,8,v,0,v,"village-square","赶集摊位");
    occupied.push({p:world(8,v),r:2.7});
  }
  for (const v of [-4.5,4.5]) {
    put(bench,0,-3.2,v,0,0,"village-square","井边坐凳");
  }
  put(cart,0,11.4,3.5,11.4,-1,"village-square","市场运货车");
  put(pots,0,10.1,-4,8,-4,"village-square","市场陶器");
  put(lamp,0,4.8,-4.8,0,0,"village-square","集会广场灯");
  put(lamp,0,4.8,4.8,0,0,"village-square","集会广场灯");

  pad(-9,0,4,baseHeight,"washing-court");
  put(trough,0,-10.3,0,-6,0,"washing-court","公共洗涤石槽");
  put(bench,0,-9,-2.5,-9,0,"washing-court","洗涤院坐凳");
  put(bench,0,-9,2.5,-9,0,"washing-court","洗涤院坐凳");
  put(pots,1,-12.3,2,-9,0,"washing-court","洗涤院陶罐");
  occupied.push({p:world(-9,0),r:4});
  occupied.push({p:world(0,0),r:6.2});

  for (const u of [-spacing,0,spacing]) {
    for (const v of [-15,15,35]) {
      put(lamp,0,u+2.1,v+1.7,u,v,"street-furniture","街巷照明");
    }
  }

  const treePoints = api.sampleProbabilityField({
    bounds:{minX:-44,maxX:44,minZ:-44,maxZ:44},
    maxPoints:65,candidates:1600,minDistance:5.5,seed:api.seed,
    guideIds:roads
  },function(s) {
    if (s.guideDistance<5 || s.waterDistance<1) return 0;
    for (const o of occupied) {
      const dx=s.x-o.p[0], dz=s.z-o.p[1];
      if (dx*dx+dz*dz<(o.r+3)*(o.r+3)) return 0;
    }
    const u=s.x*Math.cos(yaw)+s.z*Math.sin(yaw);
    const v=-s.x*Math.sin(yaw)+s.z*Math.cos(yaw);
    const edge=Math.max(Math.abs(u)/30,Math.abs(v)/39);
    return edge>1 ? 0.8 : 0.08;
  });
  let ti=0;
  for (const p of treePoints) {
    api.place({assetId:api.asset("valley-tree",ti%2),position:[p.x,p.z],rotationY:(ti*2.399)%api.TAU,scale:0.8+(ti%5)*0.085,groupId:"valley-woodland"});
    ti++;
  }
  if (ti<2) {
    for (const v of [-41,41]) {
      api.place({assetId:api.asset("valley-tree",ti%2),position:world(0,v),groupId:"valley-woodland"});
      ti++;
    }
  }

  const shrubs=api.sampleProbabilityField({
    bounds:{minX:-45,maxX:45,minZ:-45,maxZ:45},
    maxPoints:95,candidates:1800,minDistance:2.5,seed:api.seed+17,guideIds:roads
  },function(s) {
    if (s.guideDistance<3 || s.waterDistance<0.5) return 0;
    for (const o of occupied) {
      const dx=s.x-o.p[0], dz=s.z-o.p[1];
      if (dx*dx+dz*dz<(o.r+1)*(o.r+1)) return 0;
    }
    return 0.45;
  });
  let si=0;
  for (const p of shrubs) {
    api.place({assetId:api.asset("valley-shrub",si%2),position:[p.x,p.z],rotationY:(si*1.7)%api.TAU,groupId:"valley-understory"});
    si++;
  }
  if (si<2) {
    for (const u of [-39,39]) {
      api.place({assetId:api.asset("valley-shrub",si%2),position:world(u,0),groupId:"valley-understory"});
      si++;
    }
  }
  for (const side of [-1,1]) {
    api.grass({
      id:side<0?"western-meadow":"eastern-meadow",
      preset:"meadow",
      region:{kind:"polygon",points:[world(side*31,-30),world(side*35,-20),world(side*35,20),world(side*31,30)]},
      density:0.65,variation:0.45,height:0.3,mix:{short:0.7,tall:0.22,flowers:0.08},seed:api.seed+(side+1)
    });
  }
  api.spawn(world(0,-35),yaw*180/Math.PI);
  api.renderSuggestion("建议在单独确认的渲染阶段采用山谷柔和斜射日光，突出石屋高低层次、石板屋顶与可步行巷道；保留自然山体轮廓，并以少量暖色巷灯提供近人尺度。");
}

function plan(api) {
  const orientation = " Coordinate contract: Y+ is up, Z+ is the front/entrance/forward direction, X+ is right; place doors, facades, openings, windshields, or noses toward local Z+ and keep the model centered at its origin.";
  const initialSamples = [];
  for (let x = -36; x <= 36; x += 12) {
    for (let z = -36; z <= 36; z += 12) {
      const s = api.environmentSample([x, z]);
      initialSamples.push({ x: x, z: z, height: s.height, slope: s.slope });
    }
  }

  let xVariation = 0;
  let zVariation = 0;
  for (let t = -24; t <= 24; t += 12) {
    xVariation += Math.abs(api.environmentSample([-28, t]).height - api.environmentSample([28, t]).height);
    zVariation += Math.abs(api.environmentSample([t, -28]).height - api.environmentSample([t, 28]).height);
  }
  const rotate = xVariation < zVariation;
  function world(p) {
    return rotate ? [p[1], -p[0]] : [p[0], p[1]];
  }
  function distance(a, b) {
    const dx = a[0] - b[0];
    const dz = a[1] - b[1];
    return Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz);
  }
  function mix(a, b, t) {
    return [a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * t, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * t];
  }
  function segmentDistance(p, a, b) {
    const dx = b[0] - a[0];
    const dz = b[1] - a[1];
    const d = dx * dx + dz * dz;
    const t = d > 0 ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, ((p[0] - a[0]) * dx + (p[1] - a[1]) * dz) / d)) : 0;
    return distance(p, mix(a, b, t));
  }
  function asset(key, name, prompt, dimensions, role, variants, light) {
    const spec = {
      key: key,
      name: name,
      prompt: prompt + orientation,
      dimensions: dimensions,
      role: role,
      variants: variants
    };
    if (light) spec.light = light;
    return api.requireAsset(spec);
  }

  api.sceneIntent({ kind: "authored", reason: "保留已有山谷地形，通过比较街巷网络组织层层叠落的密集石屋村庄。" });

  const nodes = [
    world([-20, -24]), world([0, -24]), world([20, -24]),
    world([-20, 0]), world([0, 0]), world([20, 0]),
    world([-20, 24]), world([0, 24]), world([20, 24]),
    world([-37, -24])
  ];
  const hubs = [1, 4, 7];
  const publicSites = [
    { p: world([0, -34]), hub: 1, key: "inn", name: "南院旅舍", width: 8, depth: 7 },
    { p: world([8, 9]), hub: 4, key: "hall", name: "村民议事堂", width: 7, depth: 6 },

      name:"井场分叉院巷",
      nodes:[[0,38],[0,23],[0,7],[-16,7],[-16,-9],[-16,-24],[16,7],[16,-9],[16,-24],[28,7]],
      edges:[[0,1],[1,2],[2,3],[3,4],[4,5],[2,6],[6,7],[7,8],[6,9]],
      homes:[[-24,14,3],[-24,4,3],[-24,-7,4],[-24,-18,5],[-9,-9,4],[-9,-20,5],[24,14,6],[24,-4,7],[24,-15,8],[9,-9,7],[9,-20,8],[-7,22,1],[7,22,1],[-16,-32,5],[16,-32,8]],
      civic:[[-8,9,2],[8,9,2],[0,-3,2]]
    }
  ];
  function inspect(c) {
    let steep = false;
    let footprints = false;
    for (const edge of c.edges) {
      const a=c.nodes[edge[0]], b=c.nodes[edge[1]];
      let prev=api.environmentSample(a);
      for(let k=1;k<=6;k++){
        const p=[a[0]+(b[0]-a[0])*k/6,a[1]+(b[1]-a[1])*k/6];
        const s=api.environmentSample(p);
        const run=Math.sqrt((b[0]-a[0])*(b[0]-a[0])+(b[1]-a[1])*(b[1]-a[1]))/6;
        if(Math.abs(s.height-prev.height)/Math.max(run,0.01)>0.24) steep=true;
        prev=s;
      }
    }
    for(const h of c.homes){
      let low=16,high=-16;
      for(const d of [[-3,-3],[3,-3],[3,3],[-3,3],[0,0]]){
        const s=api.environmentSample([h[0]+d[0],h[1]+d[1]]);
        low=Math.min(low,s.height); high=Math.max(high,s.height);
      }
      if(high-low>2.5) footprints=true;
    }
    for(const h of c.civic){
      const s=api.environmentSample([h[0],h[1]]);
      const s1=api.environmentSample([h[0]-5,h[1]-4]);
      const s2=api.environmentSample([h[0]+5,h[1]+4]);
      if(Math.max(s.height,s1.height,s2.height)-Math.min(s.height,s1.height,s2.height)>3) footprints=true;
    }
    return {walkable:!steep,buildable:!footprints};
  }
  const checks=[inspect(candidates[0]),inspect(candidates[1])];
  let chosen=0;
  if(!(checks[0].walkable&&checks[0].buildable)&&checks[1].walkable&&checks[1].buildable) chosen=1;
  else if(!checks[0].buildable&&checks[1].buildable) chosen=1;
  const c=candidates[chosen];
  const heights=[];
  for(const n of c.nodes) heights.push(api.environmentSample(n).height);
  // 将局部街道坡度限制为连续可行走的坡道；只调整村落范围内的现有地形。
  for(let pass=0;pass<20;pass++){
    for(const e of c.edges){
      const a=c.nodes[e[0]],b=c.nodes[e[1]];
      const len=Math.sqrt((b[0]-a[0])*(b[0]-a[0])+(b[1]-a[1])*(b[1]-a[1]));
      const diff=heights[e[1]]-heights[e[0]],limit=len*0.16;
      if(Math.abs(diff)>limit){
        const mid=(heights[e[0]]+heights[e[1]])/2;
        const sign=diff>0?1:-1;
        heights[e[0]]=mid-sign*limit/2;
        heights[e[1]]=mid+sign*limit/2;
      }
    }
  }
  const footprints=[];
  function building(key,x,z,node,w,d,index,group){
    const target=c.nodes[node];
    const h=heights[node];
    api.sculptTerrain({mode:"flatten",point:[x,z],radius:Math.max(w,d)*0.68,strength:1,targetHeight:h});
    const dx=target[0]-x,dz=target[1]-z,len=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dz*dz);
    const door=[x+dx/Math.max(len,0.01)*(d/2+0.4),z+dz/Math.max(len,0.01)*(d/2+0.4)];
    api.rampTerrain({start:door,end:target,width:2.2,startHeight:h,endHeight:h,softness:1.5,strength:1});
    api.route({id:"door-"+group,points:[door,target],width:1.8,surface:"paving",material:"cobblestone",groupId:group});
    api.place({assetId:api.asset(key,index||0),position:[x,z],facing:{target},groupId:group});
    const side=[-dz/Math.max(len,0.01),dx/Math.max(len,0.01)];
    api.place({assetId:api.asset("goods"),position:[door[0]+side[0]*2,door[1]+side[1]*2],facing:{target},groupId:group});
    footprints.push([x,z,Math.max(w,d)*0.8]);
  }
  for(let i=0;i<c.homes.length;i++){
    const p=c.homes[i];
    building("house",p[0],p[1],p[2],5.4,5.8,i%3,"home-"+i);
  }
  const civicKeys=["bakery","inn","hall"];
  const sizes=[[7,6],[8,7],[10,7]];
  for(let i=0;i<3;i++){
    const p=c.civic[i];
    building(civicKeys[i],p[0],p[1],p[2],sizes[i][0],sizes[i][1],0,"public-"+i);
  }
  for(let i=0;i<c.nodes.length;i++){
    api.sculptTerrain({mode:"flatten",point:c.nodes[i],radius:i===2?5.5:2.8,strength:1,targetHeight:heights[i]});
  }
  for(let i=0;i<c.edges.length;i++){
    const e=c.edges[i];
    api.rampTerrain({start:c.nodes[e[0]],end:c.nodes[e[1]],width:4.4,startHeight:heights[e[0]],endHeight:heights[e[1]],softness:2,strength:1});
    api.route({id:"lane-"+i,name:c.name+"街巷",points:[c.nodes[e[0]],c.nodes[e[1]]],width:i<2?3.7:2.8,surface:"paving",material:"cobblestone"});
  }
  const plaza=c.nodes[2];
  api.surface({id:"well-square",surface:"paving",material:"garden-stone",region:{kind:"circle",center:plaza,radius:5.4},clearNatural:true});
  api.place({assetId:api.asset("fountain"),position:[plaza[0],plaza[1]+2.6],groupId:"square"});
  for(const dx of [-3.8,3.8]){
    api.place({assetId:api.asset("bench"),position:[plaza[0]+dx,plaza[1]+2.6],facing:{target:plaza},groupId:"square"});
  }
  for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
    api.place({assetId:api.asset("stall"),position:[i<2?-3.1:3.1,28+(i%2)*4],facing:{target:[0,30]},groupId:"market"});
  }
  api.surface({id:"market-court",surface:"soil",material:"compacted-earth",region:{kind:"path",points:[[0,25],[0,35]],width:10},clearNatural:true});
  api.route({id:"market-spine",points:[[0,25],[0,35]],width:3.7,surface:"paving",material:"cobblestone"});
  for(const x of [-11,-7]){
    api.place({assetId:api.asset("bench"),position:[x,14.8],facing:{target:plaza},groupId:"public-0"});
  }
  for(const x of [6,10]){
    api.place({assetId:api.asset("table"),position:[x,15],facing:{target:plaza},groupId:"public-1"});
  }
  const hall=c.civic[2],hallTarget=c.nodes[hall[2]];
  for(const dx of [-3.2,3.2]){
    api.place({assetId:api.asset("bench"),position:[hallTarget[0]+dx,hallTarget[1]+1.6],facing:{target:hallTarget},groupId:"public-2"});
  }
  api.place({assetId:api.asset("trough"),position:[-4,36],facing:{target:[0,36]},groupId:"market"});
  for(let i=0;i<c.nodes.length;i++){
    const n=c.nodes[i];
    api.place({assetId:api.asset("lamp"),position:[n[0]+2.2,n[1]+1],groupId:"street-lights"});
  }
  api.grass({id:"valley-meadow",preset:"meadow",region:{kind:"polygon",points:[[-47,-47],[47,-47],[47,47],[-47,47]]},density:0.55,height:0.28,variation:0.5,mix:{short:0.75,tall:0.2,flowers:0.05}});
  const natural=api.poissonDisk({bounds:{minX:-44,maxX:44,minZ:-44,maxZ:44},minDistance:5,maxPoints:110,seed:api.seed});
  let trees=0;
  for(const p of natural){
    if(Math.abs(p[0])<31&&p[1]>-40&&p[1]<40) continue;
    const s=api.environmentSample(p);
    if(s.slope<0.65){
      api.place({assetId:api.asset("tree",trees%2),position:[p[0],p[1]],scale:0.75+0.25*Math.abs(Math.sin(p[0]*1.7+p[1])),rotationY:p[0],role:"environment"});
      trees++;
    } else {
      api.place({assetId:api.asset("rock"),position:[p[0],p[1]],rotationY:p[1],role:"environment"});
    }
  }
  // 保证自然资产的两种树冠以及裸岩均有可见实例。
  for(let i=0;i<2;i++){
    api.place({assetId:api.asset("tree",i),position:[-37+i*74,32],role:"environment"});
  }
  api.place({assetId:api.asset("rock"),position:[-36,-34],role:"environment"});
  api.spawn([0,37],180);
  api.renderSuggestion("从南侧入口的行人视角及西南上方观察山谷石屋的高低错落。保留自然山坡，突出灰石、旧木、板岩屋顶与草地的材质区别；建议柔和傍晚侧光，街灯只补充邻近街巷照明。");
}

function plan(api) {

  const fountain = asset("village-fountain","石泉水池","Standalone low octagonal carved stone communal fountain, central short water spout and shallow basin, weathered stone coping, no surrounding ground, no background.",[3.2,2,3.2]);
  const stall = asset("market-stall","木棚摊位","Standalone compact rustic produce stall, timber trestles and striped faded linen canopy, baskets of vegetables and bread integrated on counter, front service opening, no lettering, ground or background.",[2.8,3,2.2],2);
  const bench = asset("village-bench","木石长凳","Standalone rustic wooden bench with heavy stone feet and timber backrest, sitting front faces Z+, no ground or background.",[2.4,1,0.7]);

  const trough = asset("wash-trough","公共洗衣槽","Standalone long fieldstone public wash trough, two washing slabs and timber bucket attached beside basin, no surrounding ground or background.",[3.4,1.1,1.4]);

  const treeKey = api.requireAsset({key:"valley-tree",name:"山谷乔木",prompt:"Standalone mature mountain deciduous tree, irregular airy branching crown, rugged trunk, natural varied foliage, no ground or background."+orient,dimensions:[6,10,6],variants:2,role:"environment"});
  const shrubKey = api.requireAsset({key:"valley-shrub",name:"山坡灌丛",prompt:"Standalone naturally irregular cluster of mountain shrubs and fern fronds, no ground or background."+orient,dimensions:[2.5,1.7,2.3],role:"environment"});
  const rockKey = api.requireAsset({key:"valley-rock",name:"山坡岩块",prompt:"Standalone weathered angular grey mountain rock outcrop with cracks and sparse moss in crevices, no ground or background."+orient,dimensions:[3.5,2.7,3],role:"environment"});

  const readings = [];
  for (let x=-32;x<=32;x+=8) {

    }
  }
  let best = null;
  for (const center of [[-6,-6],[6,-6],[-6,6],[6,6],[0,0]]) {
    for (const angle of [0,Math.PI/4,Math.PI/2,3*Math.PI/4]) {
      let score=0;
      const c=Math.cos(angle),s=Math.sin(angle);
      for (const uv of [[0,0],[0,-26],[0,26],[-17,-18],[17,-18],[-17,18],[17,18],[-7,0],[7,0]]) {
        const p=[center[0]+uv[0]*c-uv[1]*s,center[1]+uv[0]*s+uv[1]*c];
        const sample=api.environmentSample(p);
        score+=sample.slope*5+sample.height*0.25;
        if (sample.waterDistance<2) score+=200;
      }
      if (best===null || score<best.score) best={center:center,angle:angle,score:score};

  }
  const cs=Math.cos(best.angle),sn=Math.sin(best.angle);

        let chosen=candidate.slope*3+(candidate.waterDistance<2?100:0);
        for (const delta of [-1.1,1.1]) {
          const ss=ground(u,v+delta);
          const cost=ss.slope*3+(ss.waterDistance<2?100:0);
          if (cost<chosen) {chosen=cost;localV=v+delta;}
        }
        const corners=[[-2.7,-2.8],[2.7,-2.8],[-2.7,2.8],[2.7,2.8]];
        let minH=100,maxH=-100;
        for (const corner of corners) {
          const ss=ground(u+corner[0],localV+corner[1]);
          minH=Math.min(minH,ss.height);
          maxH=Math.max(maxH,ss.height);
        }
        setPad(u,localV,4.1);

      }

  }

  path("east-lane",[[12.7,30],[12.7,23],[12.7,16],[12.7,8],[8,5],[8,-5],[12.7,-8],[12.7,-17],[12.7,-26],[6,-30],[0,-30]],2.7);
  path("south-cross",[[ -12.7,30],[0,30],[12.7,30]],2.8);

  path("lower-cross",[[-12.7,21],[0,21],[12.7,21]],2.3);
  path("upper-cross",[[-12.7,13],[0,13],[12.7,13]],2.2);
  path("hall-entrance",[[0,-3],[0,-8.9]],3.6);
  path("bakery-entrance",[[4,0],[8,0],[9.9,0]],3);
  path("wash-court-entrance",[[-4,0],[-8,0],[-13,0]],2.8);

  put(bakery,0,13,0,[0,0],"bakery-court");
  put(fountain,0,0,0,[0,8],"village-square");

  for (let i=0;i<3;i++) {
    put(stall,i%2,4.8,(-4+i*3.6),[0,-4+i*3.6],"bakery-court");
  }

    put(bench,0,item[0],item[1],[item[2],item[3]],item[1]<-6?"public-hall":"village-square");
  }
  for (const item of [[9,-4],[17,-3],[-15,1.5],[-11,-2.5],[-5,-15],[5,-15]]) {
    put(supplies,0,item[0],item[1],[0,0],"public-support");
  }
  for (const b of buildings) {
    const group="home-"+b.index;
    const inward=b.lane>b.u?1:-1;
    const doorU=b.u+inward*2.8;
    path("door-path-"+b.index,[[b.lane,b.v],[doorU,b.v]],1.35);
    const h=put(home,b.index%3,b.u,b.v,[b.lane,b.v],group);
    api.foundation({under:[h],shape:"rounded-rectangle",position:world(b.u,b.v),width:6,depth:6,top:"level",thickness:0.12,maxThickness:2.2,material:"stone"});
    put(supplies,b.index%2,doorU,b.v+1.8,[b.lane,b.v+1.8],group);
    if (b.index%3===0) put(bench,0,doorU,b.v-1.8,[b.lane,b.v-1.8],group);
  }

  for (const p of [[-7,6],[7,6],[-7,-6],[7,-6],[-11,14],[11,14],[-11,-18],[11,-18],[1.9,26],[-1.9,-29]]) {

  const woodland=api.sampleProbabilityField({bounds:{minX:-44,maxX:44,minZ:-44,maxZ:44},maxPoints:75,candidates:650,minDistance:4.6,seed:api.seed},function(s) {

  api.environmentSample(entry);

  api.renderSuggestion("山谷石屋村庄，突出灰色石墙、旧石板屋顶与自然植被；建议侧向柔和日光展示顺坡高低错落的屋顶、窄巷与公共广场。保留可读的街巷阴影和温暖灯笼，渲染阶段再确认光照与曝光。");
}

停止追加样本后的判断

用户对下面斜向山谷第 1 次的三张图给出的目测判断是：第 1、2 张形态异常，疑似降质；第 3 张形态完整。这个标注是人工形态判断，不是已证实的模型服务分档，也不能据此推算降质发生率。当前 18 个规划槽位只有 14 个保存成功，且有效视觉样本更少，不适合用三组的道路数量中位数宣布哪种提示更好。

首版 Code 解释了这三张图为何不同：第 1 张调用了 6 次环境采样，却没有用采样值决定路网；第 2 张确实准备两套候选，但只用坡度和相邻点高差打分，无法判断节点为何连接、道路是否服务房屋和广场；第 3 张先比较两种连接结构，再给 24 座住宅与公共建筑分别接门前短路并局部整地。因此其 35 条“道路”中只有 6 条街巷骨架、2 条公共连接，其余 27 条是门前短路。217 个灰盒物件也包含大量地基、墙段和装饰，不能直接当成独立建筑数量。

第 3 张的组织层次更完整，却仍偏规则：其主体建筑中心标高跨度只有 0.81m，说明“看起来没有降质”和“真正顺应地形形成多层聚落”是两项不同判断。这里的规划 API api.route 只记录模型给的折线并铺路面，不会主动把路变成方格；直线或抽搐形态首先出自模型写入的点和选择准则。现有证据支持“只让模型读取地形不够、候选比较目标过窄、缺少建筑入口与高差关系”这些原因；不足以证明模型服务确实降档，或证明定性提示稳定胜出。

    const spec = {assetId:api.asset(key,index),position:world(u,v),name:name,groupId:group};
    if (target) spec.facing = {target:world(target[0],target[1])};
    return api.place(spec);
  }

  // A gently meandering spine and two contour-following side lanes.
  const columns = [-30,-20,-10,0,10,20,30];
  const lanes = [];
  for (let row=0; row<3; row++) {
    const lane = [];
    const base = (row-1)*14;
    for (const u of columns) {
      let chosen = base, cost = 1000000;
      for (const delta of [-1.5,0,1.5]) {
        const v = base+delta;
        const e = api.environmentSample(world(u,v));
        const previous = lane.length > 0 ? lane[lane.length-1] : null;
        let value = e.slope*3+Math.abs(delta)*0.3;
        if (previous) value += Math.abs(e.height-previous.h)*2;
        if (e.waterDistance < 2) value += 100;
        if (value < cost) { cost=value; chosen=v; }
      }
      const p = world(u,chosen);
      lane.push({u:u,v:chosen,h:api.environmentSample(p).height});
    }
    lanes.push(lane);
  }
  const civic = lanes[1][3];
  const plaza = world(0,civic.v);
  const plazaHeight = api.environmentSample(plaza).height;
  api.sculptTerrain({mode:"flatten",point:plaza,radius:6.8,strength:1,targetHeight:plazaHeight});
  api.environmentSample(plaza);
  api.surface({id:"village-square",surface:"paving",material:"garden-stone",region:{kind:"circle",center:plaza,radius:6.4},clearNatural:true});

  function street(id,nodes,width) {
    const points = [];
    for (const n of nodes) points.push(world(n.u,n.v));
    for (let i=0;i<points.length-1;i++) {
      const a = api.environmentSample(points[i]);
      const b = api.environmentSample(points[i+1]);
      api.rampTerrain({start:points[i],end:points[i+1],width:width+0.8,startHeight:a.height,endHeight:b.height,softness:1.4,strength:1});
    }
    for (const p of points) api.environmentSample(p);
    return api.route({id:id,points:points,width:width,surface:"paving",material:"cobblestone",curve:"polyline"});
  }
  const routeIds = [];
  for (let r=0;r<3;r++) routeIds.push(street("contour-lane-"+r,lanes[r],r===1 ? 3.6 : 2.5));
  for (const i of [0,3,6]) {
    street("connecting-alley-"+i,[lanes[0][i],lanes[1][i],lanes[2][i]],2.5);
  }
  const entry = [{u:-39,v:lanes[1][0].v+4},{u:-35,v:lanes[1][0].v+1},lanes[1][0]];
  street("valley-entry",entry,3.5);
  api.spawn(world(-37,lanes[1][0].v+2),90);

  function building(key,index,u,v,target,width,depth,group) {
    const p = world(u,v);
    const probes = [[0,0],[-width/2,-depth/2],[width/2,-depth/2],[-width/2,depth/2],[width/2,depth/2]];
    let h = 0;
    for (const q of probes) h += api.environmentSample(world(u+q[0],v+q[1])).height;
    h /= probes.length;
    h = Math.min(15.3,Math.max(0,h));
    api.sculptTerrain({mode:"flatten",point:p,radius:Math.max(width,depth)*0.64,strength:1,targetHeight:h});
    api.environmentSample(p);
    const ref = put(key,index,u,v,target,key+"-"+group,group);
    api.foundation({name:"顺坡石砌基座",under:[ref],shape:"rounded-rectangle",margin:0.15,top:"level",thickness:0.25,maxThickness:2,material:"stone"});
    const dx=target[0]-u, dz=target[1]-v;
    const length=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dz*dz);
    const ux=length>0 ? dx/length : 0, uz=length>0 ? dz/length : 1;
    const door = {u:u+ux*(depth/2+0.15),v:v+uz*(depth/2+0.15)};
    street("door-"+group,[door,{u:target[0],v:target[1]}],1.35);
    return {u:door.u,v:door.v,ux:ux,uz:uz};
  }

  let houseIndex = 0;
  for (let i=0;i<columns.length;i++) {
    for (const band of [-21,-7,7,21]) {
      const u=columns[i];
      if (i===0 || i===6) {
        if (band===-7 || band===7) continue;
      }
      if (Math.abs(u)<7 && Math.abs(band)<10) continue;
      const row = band < -10 ? 0 : band > 10 ? 2 : 1;
      const lane=lanes[row][i];
      const v = lane.v + (band < -10 ? -7 : band > 10 ? 7 : band);
      const group="home-"+houseIndex;
      const door=building("house",houseIndex%3,u,v,[u,lane.v],6.2,5.2,group);
      put("wares",0,door.u+2.05,door.v,[u,lane.v],"门旁柴薪陶罐",group);
      if (houseIndex%3===0) put("bench",0,door.u-2,door.v,[u,lane.v],"门前歇脚长椅",group);
      houseIndex++;
    }
  }

  building("hall",0,0,civic.v-8.8,[0,civic.v-4.5],10,6.5,"assembly");
  put("well",0,1.7,civic.v+1.3,[0,civic.v+4],"公共水井","square");
  for (const u of [-4.5,4.5]) {
    put("bench",0,u,civic.v+3.4,[0,civic.v],"井边长椅","square");
    put("bench",0,u,civic.v-2,[0,civic.v],"会堂前座椅","assembly");
  }
  for (let i=0;i<3;i++) {
    put("stall",i%2,-3.4+i*3.4,civic.v+6,[0,civic.v],"村庄集市摊位","market");
  }
  street("market-front",[{u:-5,v:civic.v+4.2},{u:5,v:civic.v+4.2}],1.8);
  put("cart",0,6,civic.v+7.5,[6,civic.v+4],"集市运货车","market");
  put("wares",0,-5,civic.v+7.4,[0,civic.v],"摊后储物","market");

  const east=lanes[1][6];
  building("chapel",0,34,east.v+8,[34,east.v],6.5,8,"chapel");
  street("chapel-approach",[east,{u:34,v:east.v},{u:34,v:east.v+3.8}],2.2);
  put("trough",0,32,east.v-3,[30,east.v],"礼堂旁公共饮水槽","chapel");
  for (const u of [31,36]) put("bench",0,u,east.v+2,[34,east.v+5],"礼堂小院座椅","chapel");

  // Vegetation stays outside the inhabited strips, preserving the tight village interior.
  api.grass({id:"valley-meadow",preset:"meadow",region:{kind:"polygon",points:[[-47,-47],[47,-47],[47,47],[-47,47]]},density:0.48,height:0.3,variation:0.65,mix:{short:0.65,tall:0.25,flowers:0.1}});
  let trees=0;
  const nature=api.poissonDisk({bounds:{minX:-44,maxX:44,minZ:-44,maxZ:44},minDistance:4.8,maxPoints:180,seed:api.seed});
  for (const p of nature) {
    const dx=p[0]-best.cx, dz=p[1]-best.cz;
    const u=dx*best.c+dz*best.s, v=-dx*best.s+dz*best.c;
    if (Math.abs(u)<39 && Math.abs(v)<27) continue;
    if (u < -29 && Math.abs(v-lanes[1][0].v)<8) continue;
    const e=api.environmentSample(p);
    if (e.waterDistance<1.5) continue;
    if (e.slope<0.75 && trees<44) {
      const pine=e.slope>0.35 || trees%3===0;
      api.place({assetId:api.asset(pine ? "pine" : "tree",pine ? 0 : trees%2),position:p,rotationY:trees*2.399,scale:0.8+(trees%4)*0.1});
      trees++;
    } else {
      api.place({assetId:api.asset(e.slope>0.7 ? "rock" : "shrub",0),position:p,rotationY:trees*0.7});
    }
  }
  for (let i=0;i<6;i++) {
    const u=-25+i*10;
    const p=world(u,29+(i%2)*2);
    const e=api.environmentSample(p);
    if (e.waterDistance>1) api.place({assetId:api.asset("shrub",0),position:p});
  }
  api.place({assetId:api.asset("rock",0),position:world(-32,30),rotationY:0.8});
  api.renderSuggestion("以斜向高处视角展示山谷村庄的密集石屋、顺坡石基、错落屋顶与三条互通街巷；采用柔和日间侧光，保留公共广场、步行通道与周围山坡的清晰空间关系。");
}

function plan(api) {
  api.sceneIntent({kind:"authored",reason:"沿既有山谷地形组织密集石屋、公共院落和连续步行街巷。"});
  const orientation = " Coordinate contract: Y+ is up, Z+ is the front/entrance/forward direction, X+ is right; place doors, facades, openings, windshields, or noses toward local Z+ and keep the model centered at its origin.";
  function asset(key,name,prompt,dimensions,variants) {
    api.requireAsset({key:key,name:name,prompt:prompt+orientation,dimensions:dimensions,variants:variants,role:"structure"});
  }
  asset("home","山谷石屋","Standalone narrow mountain village dwelling, rough load-bearing stone masonry, two uneven storeys, slate roof, chimney, deep timber windows, entrance at ground level on front, attached shutters and small upper wooden balcony. No ground or background.",[6,7.8,6],3);
  asset("hall","村民会堂","Standalone mountain village communal hall, thick stone walls, broad slate gable, small bell turret, front double timber door at ground level, arched windows and joined entrance canopy; no ground or background.",[11,10,8],1);
  asset("inn","石屋客栈","Standalone mountain village inn, three storeys of rough stone, slate roof, front ground-level entrance and open timber veranda integrated into facade, windows and chimney; no ground or background.",[9,10,7],1);
  asset("workshop","村庄工坊","Standalone stone village bakery and craft workshop, slate roof, ground-level wide front doorway, integrated open work counter, visible oven and shelves inside front opening, stone chimney; no ground or background.",[8,6,6],1);
  asset("stall","木棚摊位","Standalone small village market stall with timber frame, woven canopy, baskets of vegetables and pottery on counter, open front; no ground, writing or background.",[2.6,2.8,1.8],2);
  asset("bench","石脚长凳","Standalone reusable village bench with stone feet and weathered timber seat, front towards Z+, no ground or background.",[2,0.85,0.65],1);
  asset("well","公共水井","Standalone octagonal mountain village stone well with raised stone rim, timber winch, rope and bucket, no ground or background.",[2.5,3.5,2.5],1);
  asset("domestic","门前生活器物","Standalone compact household grouping of split firewood, two ceramic storage jars and a woven basket beside a low timber shelf, no ground or background.",[1.6,1.2,0.8],2);
  asset("trough","石制水槽","Standalone carved village stone drinking trough with short integrated hand pump and bucket, no ground or background.",[2.2,1.5,1],1);
  asset("lamp","街巷灯柱","Standalone village wrought iron lantern on a stone-footed timber post, enclosed glass lamp mounted near top, no ground or background.",[0.5,3.3,0.5],1);
  api.requireAsset({key:"tree",name:"山谷乔木",prompt:"Standalone mature mountain valley deciduous tree with irregular branching, open crown and visible trunk, no ground or background."+orientation,dimensions:[6,11,6],variants:2,role:"environment"});
  api.requireAsset({key:"shrub",name:"山地灌木",prompt:"Standalone natural mountain shrub with irregular dense leaves and a few exposed branches, no ground or background."+orientation,dimensions:[2.5,1.8,2.5],role:"environment"});
  // 两个拓扑不同的候选：南北主街与支巷；西侧入口与环街。
  const nodes = [[0,-40],[0,-25],[0,-9],[0,8],[0,25],[0,39],[-16,-25],[-16,-9],[-16,8],[-16,25],[16,-25],[16,-9],[16,8],[16,25],[-39,-9]];
  const networks = [
    [[0,1],[1,2],[2,3],[3,4],[4,5],[1,6],[2,7],[3,8],[4,9],[1,10],[2,11],[3,12],[4,13],[6,7],[8,9],[11,12]],
    [[14,7],[7,6],[6,1],[1,10],[10,11],[11,12],[12,13],[13,4],[4,9],[9,8],[8,7],[7,2],[2,3],[3,12],[3,4],[4,5]]
  ];
  const samples = [];
  for (const p of nodes) samples.push(api.environmentSample(p));
  const homes = [];
  for (const x of [-25,-7,7,25]) {
    for (const z of [-29,-18,-1,16,29]) {
      let tx = x < -16 ? -16 : x < 0 ? 0 : x < 16 ? 0 : 16;
      homes.push({p:[x,z],target:[tx,z]});
    }
  }
  function score(edges) {
    let value = 0;
    for (const e of edges) {
      const a=nodes[e[0]], b=nodes[e[1]];
      const dx=b[0]-a[0], dz=b[1]-a[1];
      const length=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dz*dz);
      const mid=api.environmentSample([(a[0]+b[0])*0.5,(a[1]+b[1])*0.5]);
      value += length*0.035 + Math.abs(samples[e[0]].height-samples[e[1]].height)*2 + mid.slope*length*0.12;
    }
    for (const h of homes) {
      const center=api.environmentSample(h.p);
      let variation=0;
      for (const offset of [[-3,-3],[3,-3],[3,3],[-3,3]]) {
        variation+=Math.abs(api.environmentSample([h.p[0]+offset[0],h.p[1]+offset[1]]).height-center.height);
      }
      let distance=100;
      for (const e of edges) {
        const a=nodes[e[0]],b=nodes[e[1]],dx=b[0]-a[0],dz=b[1]-a[1];
        const t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,((h.target[0]-a[0])*dx+(h.target[1]-a[1])*dz)/Math.max(1,dx*dx+dz*dz)));
        const ex=h.target[0]-a[0]-t*dx,ez=h.target[1]-a[1]-t*dz;
        distance=Math.min(distance,Math.sqrt(ex*ex+ez*ez));
      }
      value+=variation*0.4+distance*1.5;
    }
    return value;
  }
  const first=score(networks[0]), second=score(networks[1]);
  const selected=first<=second ? networks[0] : networks[1];
  const routeSegments=[];
  function street(id,points,width) {
    for(let i=0;i<points.length-1;i++){
      api.rampTerrain({start:points[i],end:points[i+1],width:width+1.5,softness:0.8,strength:1});
      routeSegments.push([points[i],points[i+1]]);
    }
    return api.route({id:id,points:points,width:width,curve:"polyline",surface:"paving",material:"cobblestone"});
  }
  for(let i=0;i<selected.length;i++){
    const e=selected[i];
    street("street-"+i,[nodes[e[0]],nodes[e[1]]],e[0]<6 && e[1]<6 ? 3.6 : 2.7);
  }
  function closest(p) {
    let best=[0,0], distance=100000;
    for(const s of routeSegments){
      const a=s[0],b=s[1],dx=b[0]-a[0],dz=b[1]-a[1];
      const t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,((p[0]-a[0])*dx+(p[1]-a[1])*dz)/Math.max(0.001,dx*dx+dz*dz)));
      const q=[a[0]+t*dx,a[1]+t*dz];
      const d=(p[0]-q[0])*(p[0]-q[0])+(p[1]-q[1])*(p[1]-q[1]);
      if(d<distance){distance=d;best=q;}
    }
    return best;
  }
  for(let i=0;i<homes.length;i++){
    const h=homes[i], p=h.p;
    const direction=p[0]<h.target[0] ? 1 : -1;
    const door=[p[0]+direction*3,p[1]];
    const height=api.environmentSample(door).height;
    api.sculptTerrain({mode:"flatten",point:p,radius:4.6,strength:1,targetHeight:height});
    const q=closest(door);
    street("door-"+i,[door,q],1.5);
    api.place({assetId:api.asset("home",i%3),position:p,facing:{target:h.target},groupId:"homes"});
    api.place({assetId:api.asset("domestic",i%2),position:[door[0],door[1]+2],facing:{target:h.target},groupId:"homes"});
  }
  const publicAreas=[
    {id:"assembly",p:[-8,40],key:"hall",depth:8,court:[-8,32],radius:5.2},
    {id:"market",p:[27,8],key:"workshop",depth:6,court:[19,8],radius:5},
    {id:"inn-yard",p:[-27,8],key:"inn",depth:7,court:[-19,8],radius:4.8}
  ];
  for(const area of publicAreas){
    const p=area.p,c=area.court;
    const height=api.environmentSample(c).height;
    api.sculptTerrain({mode:"flatten",point:p,radius:7,strength:1,targetHeight:height});
    api.sculptTerrain({mode:"flatten",point:c,radius:area.radius+0.7,strength:1,targetHeight:height});
    api.surface({id:area.id+"-square",surface:"paving",material:"garden-stone",region:{kind:"circle",center:c,radius:area.radius},clearNatural:true});
    const dx=c[0]-p[0],dz=c[1]-p[1],length=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dz*dz);
    const door=[p[0]+dx/length*area.depth/2,p[1]+dz/length*area.depth/2];
    const q=closest(c);
    street(area.id+"-access",[door,c,q],2.2);
    api.place({assetId:api.asset(area.key,0),position:p,facing:{target:c},groupId:area.id});
    for(let j=0;j<3;j++){
      const offset=(j-1)*2.6;
      api.place({assetId:api.asset("bench",0),position:[c[0]+offset,c[1]+3.5],facing:{target:c},groupId:area.id});
    }
    api.place({assetId:api.asset("trough",0),position:[c[0]-3.5,c[1]-2.5],facing:{target:c},groupId:area.id});
    api.place({assetId:api.asset("domestic",0),position:[p[0]+2,p[1]+2],facing:{target:c},groupId:area.id});
  }
  api.place({assetId:api.asset("well",0),position:[-9,32],groupId:"assembly"});
  for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
    api.place({assetId:api.asset("stall",i%2),position:[22.5,-1+i*3],facing:{target:[17,-1+i*3]},groupId:"market"});
  }
  for(const p of [[-2,-24],[2,-8],[-2,9],[2,24],[-13,32],[17,12],[-17,12]]){
    api.place({assetId:api.asset("lamp",0),position:p});
  }
  api.grass({id:"valley-meadow",preset:"meadow",region:{kind:"polygon",points:[[-46,-46],[46,-46],[46,46],[-46,46]]},density:0.48,variation:0.7,height:0.3,mix:{short:0.65,tall:0.25,flowers:0.1}});
  let treeIndex=0;
  for(let side=-1;side<=1;side+=2){
    for(let j=0;j<10;j++){
      const x=side*(36+3*Math.sin(j*2.1)),z=-39+j*8;
      const sample=api.environmentSample([x,z]);
      if(sample.slope<1.5){
        api.place({assetId:api.asset("tree",treeIndex%2),position:[x,z],rotationY:j*1.7});
        treeIndex++;
      }
      api.place({assetId:api.asset("shrub",0),position:[side*(33+2*Math.cos(j)),z+2],rotationY:j});
    }
  }
  api.place({assetId:api.asset("tree",0),position:[-34,34]});
  api.place({assetId:api.asset("tree",1),position:[34,34]});
  const entry=first<=second ? nodes[0] : nodes[14];
  api.spawn(entry,first<=second ? 0 : 90);
  api.renderSuggestion("山谷石屋村庄，保留既有山势。以斜向俯视呈现密集屋顶、分层街巷和三处公共空间，再用行人高度观察地面连续通行；建议柔和侧向日光与山谷空气透视。");
}

  api.requireAsset({key:"lamp",name:"街巷灯",role:"structure",dimensions:[0.65,3.2,0.65],light:{kind:"point",color:"#FFD39B",intensity:1.6,range:6,offset:[0,2.7,0]},prompt:"Standalone rustic wrought iron village lamp post with a single sheltered glass lantern, no ground or background."+orientation});
  api.requireAsset({key:"tree",name:"山谷乔木",role:"environment",variants:2,dimensions:[5,10,5],prompt:"Standalone mountain valley deciduous tree, irregular branching, airy natural crown, visible trunk, no ground or background."+orientation});
  api.requireAsset({key:"rock",name:"山谷露岩",role:"environment",dimensions:[4,2.6,3],prompt:"Standalone weathered angular mountain rock outcrop, fractured natural stone, no ground or background."+orientation});

  // 两个连接拓扑不同的有界候选：纵向主街与梯形横街。
  const candidates = [
    {
      name:"谷底主街与两侧巷环",
      roads:[
        [[0,-43],[0,-22],[0,0],[0,22],[0,27]],
        [[-20,-22],[-20,0],[-20,22]],
        [[20,-22],[20,0],[20,22]],
        [[-20,-22],[0,-22],[20,-22]],
        [[-20,0],[0,0],[20,0]],
        [[-20,22],[0,22],[20,22]]
      ],
      homes:[],
      hall:[0,36], plaza:[0,26], bakery:[-13,30], bakeryAccess:[-13,22]
    },
    {
      name:"沿坡横街与双侧联络巷",
      roads:[
        [[-42,-20],[-30,-20],[0,-20],[30,-20]],
        [[-30,0],[0,0],[30,0]],
        [[-30,20],[0,20],[30,20]],
        [[-30,-20],[-30,0],[-30,20]],
        [[30,-20],[30,0],[30,20]],
        [[0,20],[0,27]]
      ],
      homes:[],
      hall:[0,36], plaza:[0,26], bakery:[-14,29], bakeryAccess:[-14,20]
    }
  ];
  for (const x of [-30,-10,10,30]) {
    for (const z of [-15,-5,7,16]) {
      let streetX = 0;
      if (x === -30) streetX = -20;
      if (x === 30) streetX = 20;
      candidates[0].homes.push({p:[x,z],access:[streetX,z]});
    }
  }
  for (const z of [-30,-10,10]) {
    for (const x of [-22,-11,0,11,22]) {
      const streetZ = z === -30 ? -20 : z === -10 ? 0 : 20;
      candidates[1].homes.push({p:[x,z],access:[x,streetZ]});
    }
  }
  function sampleFootprint(p,w,d) {
    let low = 1000;
    let high = -1000;
    let slope = 0;
    for (const dx of [-w/2,0,w/2]) {
      for (const dz of [-d/2,0,d/2]) {
        const s = api.environmentSample([p[0]+dx,p[1]+dz]);
        low = Math.min(low,s.height);
        high = Math.max(high,s.height);
        slope = Math.max(slope,s.slope);
      }
    }
    return {relief:high-low,height:api.environmentSample(p).height,slope:slope};
  }
  for (const c of candidates) {
    c.maxGrade = 0;
    c.maxRelief = 0;
    c.steepFootprint = false;
    for (const road of c.roads) {
      for (let i=0;i<road.length-1;i++) {
        const a=road[i], b=road[i+1];
        const length=Math.sqrt((b[0]-a[0])*(b[0]-a[0])+(b[1]-a[1])*(b[1]-a[1]));
        let previous=api.environmentSample(a);
        const steps=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(length/4));
        for (let j=1;j<=steps;j++) {
          const p=[a[0]+(b[0]-a[0])*j/steps,a[1]+(b[1]-a[1])*j/steps];
          const s=api.environmentSample(p);
          c.maxGrade=Math.max(c.maxGrade,Math.abs(s.height-previous.height)/(length/steps));
          previous=s;
        }
      }
    }
    for (const home of c.homes) {
      const f=sampleFootprint(home.p,7,7);
      c.maxRelief=Math.max(c.maxRelief,f.relief);
      if (f.slope>0.65) c.steepFootprint=true;
      const a=api.environmentSample(home.access);
      const dx=home.p[0]-home.access[0], dz=home.p[1]-home.access[1];
      c.maxGrade=Math.max(c.maxGrade,Math.abs(f.height-a.height)/Math.max(1,Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dz*dz)));
    }
    c.maxRelief=Math.max(c.maxRelief,sampleFootprint(c.hall,13,10).relief,sampleFootprint(c.bakery,9,7).relief);
    c.viable=c.maxGrade<=0.22 && c.maxRelief<=2.5 && !c.steepFootprint;
  }
  let chosen=candidates[0];
  if (!chosen.viable && candidates[1].viable) chosen=candidates[1];
  else if (!chosen.viable && !candidates[1].viable) {
    // 无天然低坡候选时，先排除大开挖地基，再以最大步行坡度决定局部整坡。
    if (chosen.maxRelief>3.5 && candidates[1].maxRelief<=3.5) chosen=candidates[1];
    else if ((chosen.maxRelief>3.5)===(candidates[1].maxRelief>3.5) && candidates[1].maxGrade<chosen.maxGrade) chosen=candidates[1];
  }

  const plazaHeight=api.environmentSample(chosen.plaza).height;
  const nodes=[];
  function getNode(p) {
    for (const n of nodes) {
      if (Math.abs(n.p[0]-p[0])<0.01 && Math.abs(n.p[1]-p[1])<0.01) return n;
    }
    const n={p:p,h:api.environmentSample(p).height};
    nodes.push(n);
    return n;
  }
  const roadLines=[];
  const edges=[];
  for (const road of chosen.roads) {
    const line=[];
    for (let i=0;i<road.length-1;i++) {
      const a=road[i],b=road[i+1];
      const dx=b[0]-a[0],dz=b[1]-a[1];
      const length=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dz*dz);
      const count=Math.ceil(length/3);
      for (let j=0;j<count;j++) line.push(getNode([a[0]+dx*j/count,a[1]+dz*j/count]));
    }
    line.push(getNode(road[road.length-1]));
    roadLines.push(line);
    for (let i=0;i<line.length-1;i++) {
      const a=line[i],b=line[i+1];
      const dx=b.p[0]-a.p[0],dz=b.p[1]-a.p[1];
      edges.push({a:a,b:b,limit:0.16*Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dz*dz)});
    }
  }
  for (let pass=0;pass<100;pass++) {
    for (const e of edges) {
      const difference=e.b.h-e.a.h;
      if (Math.abs(difference)>e.limit) {
        const correction=(Math.abs(difference)-e.limit)*0.5;
        if (difference>0) {e.a.h+=correction;e.b.h-=correction;}
        else {e.a.h-=correction;e.b.h+=correction;}
      }
    }
  }
  for (const e of edges) api.rampTerrain({start:e.a.p,end:e.b.p,width:4.6,startHeight:e.a.h,endHeight:e.b.h,softness:2.2,strength:1});
  for (let i=0;i<roadLines.length;i++) {
    const points=[];
    for (const n of roadLines[i]) points.push(n.p);
    api.route({id:"street-"+i,name:chosen.name+" "+(i+1),points:points,width:i===0?4.2:3.1,surface:"paving",material:"cobblestone",curve:"polyline"});
  }

  function put(key,p,target,group,variant) {
    return api.place({assetId:api.asset(key,variant || 0),position:p,facing:{target:target},groupId:group});
  }
  function lane(id,a,b,width) {
    api.rampTerrain({start:a,end:b,width:width+0.6,softness:1.2,strength:1});
    api.route({id:id,points:[a,b],width:width,surface:"paving",material:"cobblestone"});
  }
  for (let i=0;i<chosen.homes.length;i++) {
    const h=chosen.homes[i],p=h.p,a=h.access;
    const accessHeight=api.environmentSample(a).height;
    const originalHeight=api.environmentSample(p).height;
    const targetHeight=Math.max(accessHeight-0.55,Math.min(accessHeight+0.55,originalHeight));
    api.sculptTerrain({mode:"flatten",point:p,radius:5.1,targetHeight:targetHeight,strength:1});
    const dx=a[0]-p[0],dz=a[1]-p[1];
    const distance=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dz*dz);
    const nx=dx/distance,nz=dz/distance;
    const door=[p[0]+nx*3.7,p[1]+nz*3.7];
    lane("door-"+i,a,door,1.5);
    const house=put("house",p,a,"residential-"+i,i%3);
    api.foundation({name:"顺坡石屋基座",under:[house],shape:"rounded-rectangle",margin:0.12,top:"level",thickness:0.15,maxThickness:1.3,material:"stone"});
    put("domestic",[door[0]-nz*2.3,door[1]+nx*2.3],a,"residential-"+i,i%2);
    if (i%3===0) put("bench",[door[0]+nz*2.4,door[1]-nx*2.4],a,"residential-"+i,0);
    if (i%4===0) put("lamp",[a[0]-nz*2.0,a[1]+nx*2.0],p,"residential-"+i,0);
    const rear=[p[0]-nx*4.1,p[1]-nz*4.1];
    if (Math.abs(originalHeight-accessHeight)>0.65) {
      api.placeBetween({assetId:api.asset("wall",0),start:[rear[0]-nz*4,rear[1]+nx*4],end:[rear[0]+nz*4,rear[1]-nx*4],dimensions:[3,1.4,0.65],spanAxis:"x",frontTarget:a,groupId:"residential-"+i});
    }
  }

  const approach=api.environmentSample([0,22]).height;
  const publicHeight=Math.max(approach-0.45,Math.min(approach+0.45,plazaHeight));
  api.sculptTerrain({mode:"flatten",point:chosen.plaza,radius:8.1,targetHeight:publicHeight,strength:1});
  api.sculptTerrain({mode:"flatten",point:chosen.hall,radius:8.3,targetHeight:publicHeight,strength:1});
  api.surface({id:"village-square",surface:"paving",material:"garden-stone",region:{kind:"polygon",points:[[-7,22],[7,22],[7,31],[-7,31]]},clearNatural:true});
  lane("square-entry",[0,chosen===candidates[0]?22:20],[0,31],3.6);
  const hall=put("hall",chosen.hall,chosen.plaza,"commons",0);
  api.foundation({name:"会堂石基",under:[hall],shape:"rounded-rectangle",margin:0.25,thickness:0.18,maxThickness:1.5,top:"level",material:"stone"});
  put("fountain",[-4.3,26],[0,26],"commons",0);
  for (const p of [[-5.2,30],[5.2,30],[5.2,23]]) put("bench",p,[0,26],"commons",0);
  for (const p of [[-6.5,23],[6.5,30]]) put("lamp",p,[0,26],"commons",0);

  const bp=chosen.bakery;
  const bh=api.environmentSample(chosen.bakeryAccess).height;
  api.sculptTerrain({mode:"flatten",point:bp,radius:6.1,targetHeight:bh,strength:1});
  const bakery=put("bakery",bp,chosen.bakeryAccess,"market",0);
  api.foundation({name:"烘坊石基",under:[bakery],shape:"rounded-rectangle",margin:0.15,thickness:0.15,maxThickness:1.2,material:"stone"});
  lane("bakery-entry",chosen.bakeryAccess,[bp[0],bp[1]-3.6],2.1);
  lane("market-link",[bp[0],23],[0,23],2.2);
  for (let i=0;i<3;i++) {
    const p=[10.5+i*5,27];
    api.sculptTerrain({mode:"flatten",point:p,radius:2.6,targetHeight:publicHeight,strength:1});
    put("shelter",p,[p[0],23],"market",i%2);
    lane("stall-access-"+i,[p[0],23],[p[0],25.5],1.5);
  }
  lane("market-front",[0,23],[22,23],2.4);
  put("cart",[bp[0]-5.6,25],[bp[0],23],"market",0);
  put("domestic",[bp[0]+3.2,bp[1]-4.3],chosen.bakeryAccess,"market",1);
  put("bench",[22,26],[19,23],"market",0);
  put("lamp",[9,23],[15,27],"market",0);

  const streetIds=[];
  for (let i=0;i<chosen.roads.length;i++) streetIds.push("street-"+i);
  api.grass({id:"valley-meadow",preset:"meadow",region:{kind:"polygon",points:[[-47,-47],[47,-47],[47,47],[-47,47]]},density:0.55,height:0.28,variation:0.6,mix:{short:0.7,tall:0.25,flowers:0.05}});
  function clearOfVillage(x,z) {
    if (x>-25 && x<27 && z>20 && z<44) return false;
    for (const h of chosen.homes) {
      if (Math.abs(x-h.p[0])<5.7 && Math.abs(z-h.p[1])<5.7) return false;
    }
    return true;
  }
  const woodland=api.sampleProbabilityField(
    {bounds:{minX:-44,maxX:44,minZ:-44,maxZ:44},maxPoints:65,candidates:650,minDistance:5.4,guideIds:streetIds,seed:api.seed},
    function(s) {
      if (!clearOfVillage(s.x,s.z) || s.guideDistance<5) return 0;
      const outer=Math.max(Math.abs(s.x),Math.abs(s.z));
      return outer>34?0.85:0.12;
    }
  );
  for (let i=0;i<woodland.length;i++) {
    api.place({assetId:api.asset("tree",i%2),position:[woodland[i].x,woodland[i].z],rotationY:(i*2.399)%api.TAU,scale:0.8+(i%5)*0.09});
  }
  const rocks=api.sampleProbabilityField(
    {bounds:{minX:-44,maxX:44,minZ:-44,maxZ:44},maxPoints:16,candidates:180,minDistance:5,guideIds:streetIds,seed:api.seed+9},
    function(s) {
      if (!clearOfVillage(s.x,s.z) || s.guideDistance<6) return 0;
      return Math.max(Math.abs(s.x),Math.abs(s.z))>35?0.65:0;
    }
  );
  for (let i=0;i<rocks.length;i++) api.place({assetId:api.asset("rock",0),position:[rocks[i].x,rocks[i].z],rotationY:i*1.7,scale:0.7+(i%4)*0.2});
  const entry=chosen.roads[0][0];
  api.spawn(entry,chosen===candidates[0]?0:90);
  api.environmentSample(entry,{guideIds:streetIds});
  api.environmentSample(chosen.plaza,{guideIds:streetIds});
  api.environmentSample([30,32],{guideIds:streetIds});
  api.renderSuggestion("从村口步行视角展示随坡抬升的密集石屋与相连巷道，并以侧上方视角呈现谷地地形、层叠石板屋顶、会堂和泉水广场；建议柔和傍晚日光、自然石材质感与克制的暖色街灯。");
}

高差地形读图重点

滑雪场高度场整体有 0～15.95m 高差，但这 6 张灰盒中有 5 张的主体建筑中心标高跨度不超过 0.69m。另有一张达到 7.69m，原因是放了一座高处驿舍；不能说所有建筑都在坡底。以 4m 网格抽样、8×7m 建筑占地四角高差不超过 1m 作粗略检查，0～2m 标高有 312 个候选中心，6～8m 只有 5 个，14～16m 只有 1 个；候选中心会重叠，不能当作可建房屋数。模型集中低地有地形原因；要得到真正多层的聚落，需要连同建筑占地、局部筑台和上下通路一起设计。

“定性选择”是给模型的提示目标，不代表它每次照做：滑雪场第 1 张定性样本仍写了数值 routeCost。道路更弯或更少也不能单独证明适地、可走或立体。高差组 4 个初次失败样本在统一补明 rampTerrain 的 softness/strength 范围 0～1 后重试成功，报告逐卡标注了这一差别。

function plan(api) {
  api.sceneIntent({kind:"authored",reason:"保留现有雪山，以实测坡度、标高及连通成本选择村落组团，陡段使用台阶。"});
  const orient = " Coordinate contract: Y+ is up, Z+ is the front/entrance/forward direction, X+ is right; place doors, facades, openings, windshields, or noses toward local Z+ and keep the model centered at its origin.";
  function asset(key,name,prompt,dimensions) {
    api.requireAsset({key,name,prompt:prompt+orient,dimensions,role:"structure"});
    return api.asset(key,0);
  }
  const house = asset("stone-house","雪山石屋","Standalone compact mountain dwelling of rough local stone, heavy timber snow-shedding roof with patches of snow, chimney, recessed front door and small windows, joined wooden shutters, no ground or background.",[5,5.4,5]);
  const hall = asset("village-hall","村庄会堂","Standalone alpine village communal stone hall, steep timber roof with snow patches, central front entrance, attached porch, narrow windows and chimney; no ground or background.",[6,6,5]);
  const shelter = asset("rest-shelter","休憩亭","Standalone open mountain rest shelter, four sturdy timber posts, steep snow-covered roof, integrated back bench, open front; no ground or background.",[4,3.8,3]);
  const bench = asset("stone-bench","石木长椅","Standalone sturdy mountain bench with stone legs and timber seat and back, front toward Z+, no ground.",[2,0.95,0.65]);
  const wood = asset("firewood","储薪架","Standalone covered split-firewood rack with timber supports and small pitched roof carrying patches of snow, no ground.",[2,1.8,1]);
  const trough = asset("trough","石槽","Standalone mountain village carved stone water trough with timber spout, lightly icy rim, no surrounding ground.",[2,1,1]);
  const step = asset("stone-step","石阶踏步","Single solid rough stone stair tread, level top and vertical riser, canonical width 2.2 meters along X, height 0.16 meters, depth 0.42 meters along Z; reusable traversal component, no ground.",[2.2,0.16,0.42]);
  const sign = asset("trail-sign","山路指示牌","Standalone timber mountain trail wayfinding post with two joined arrow boards bearing carved directional pictograms without lettering, snow cap, no ground.",[0.85,1.8,0.35]);

  const nodes = [];
  const n = 9;
  for (let iz=0; iz<n; iz++) {
    for (let ix=0; ix<n; ix++) {
      const x=-36+ix*9, z=-36+iz*9;
      const s=api.environmentSample([x,z]);
      nodes.push({x,z,h:s.height,slope:s.slope,wet:s.waterDistance<1,ix,iz});
    }
  }
  function neighbors(i) {
    const p=nodes[i], out=[];
    if(p.ix>0) out.push(i-1);
    if(p.ix<n-1) out.push(i+1);
    if(p.iz>0) out.push(i-n);
    if(p.iz<n-1) out.push(i+n);
    return out;
  }
  const edges=[];
  for(let i=0;i<nodes.length;i++){
    const list=[];
    for(const j of neighbors(i)){
      const a=nodes[i], b=nodes[j];
      let prev=a.h, steep=0, rough=0, wet=false;
      for(let k=1;k<=4;k++){
        const t=k/4;
        const s=api.environmentSample([a.x+(b.x-a.x)*t,a.z+(b.z-a.z)*t]);
        steep=Math.max(steep,Math.abs(s.height-prev)/2.25);
        rough+=Math.abs(s.height-prev);
        if(s.waterDistance<0.6) wet=true;
        prev=s.height;
      }
      list.push({j,cost:wet?100000:9+rough*6+Math.max(0,steep-0.16)*65,steep});
    }
    edges.push(list);
  }

  const candidates=[];
  const offsets=[[-4.5,-4.5],[4.5,-4.5],[-4.5,4.5],[4.5,4.5]];
  for(let i=0;i<nodes.length;i++){
    const p=nodes[i];
    if(p.ix<1||p.ix>7||p.iz<1||p.iz>7||p.wet) continue;
    const plots=[];
    for(const o of offsets){
      const x=p.x+o[0],z=p.z+o[1];
      const center=api.environmentSample([x,z]);
      let lo=center.height,hi=center.height,wet=false;
      for(const dx of [-2.8,2.8]){
        for(const dz of [-2.8,2.8]){
          const q=api.environmentSample([x+dx,z+dz]);
          lo=Math.min(lo,q.height); hi=Math.max(hi,q.height);
          if(q.waterDistance<1) wet=true;
        }
      }
      if(!wet&&hi-lo<2.6&&Math.abs(center.height-p.h)<3.1)
        plots.push({x,z,h:center.height,relief:hi-lo});
    }
    if(plots.length>=3){
      let score=0;
      for(const q of plots) score+=q.relief;
      score+=Math.abs(p.h-6)*0.08+(Math.abs(p.x)+Math.abs(p.z))*0.015;
      candidates.push({i,plots,score});
    }
  }
  let best=null;
  for(const c of candidates) if(best===null||c.score<best.score) best=c;
  if(best===null){
    let i=40;
    for(let j=0;j<nodes.length;j++){
      if(!nodes[j].wet&&nodes[j].slope<nodes[i].slope)i=j;
    }
    const p=nodes[i],plots=[];
    for(const o of offsets){
      const x=p.x+o[0],z=p.z+o[1];
      const s=api.environmentSample([x,z]);
      plots.push({x,z,h:s.height,relief:2});
    }
    best={i,plots,score:0};
  }

  const dist=[],parent=[],done=[];
  for(let i=0;i<nodes.length;i++){dist.push(1000000);parent.push(-1);done.push(false);}
  dist[best.i]=0;
  for(let k=0;k<nodes.length;k++){
    let u=-1;
    for(let i=0;i<nodes.length;i++)if(!done[i]&&(u<0||dist[i]<dist[u]))u=i;
    if(u<0||dist[u]>=1000000)break;
    done[u]=true;
    for(const e of edges[u]){
      if(dist[u]+e.cost<dist[e.j]){
        dist[e.j]=dist[u]+e.cost;
        parent[e.j]=u;
      }
    }
  }
  const groups=[best];
  for(let g=1;g<3;g++){

      }
      const value=c.score+dist[c.i]*0.055;
      if(separated&&dist[c.i]<350&&value<score){chosen=c;score=value;}

    if(chosen!==null)groups.push(chosen);
  }

  let routeCount=0;
  function walk(points,name,width) {
    for(let i=0;i<points.length-1;i++){
      const a=points[i],b=points[i+1];

    }
    const id=api.route({id:"walk-"+routeCount,name,points,width,surface:"paving",material:"garden-stone",curve:"polyline"});
    routeCount++;
    for(let i=0;i<points.length-1;i++){
      const a=points[i],b=points[i+1];
      const sa=api.environmentSample(a),sb=api.environmentSample(b);
      const dx=b[0]-a[0],dz=b[1]-a[1],len=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dz*dz);
      const rise=Math.abs(sb.height-sa.height);
      if(len>0.1&&rise/len>0.17){
        const count=Math.max(2,Math.ceil(rise/0.16));
        for(let k=0;k<count;k++){
          const t=(k+0.5)/count;

        }
      }
    }
    return id;
  }

      }
      u=v;
    }
  }

    api.place({assetId:trough,position:[p.x-1.35,p.z+0.5],facing:{target:[p.x,p.z]},scale:[0.7,0.85,0.7],groupId});

      const isPublic=j===0;
      const aid=isPublic?(gi===0?hall:shelter):house;
      const depth=isPublic&&gi>0?3:5;
      const entrance=[q.x+ux*(depth/2+0.3),q.z+uz*(depth/2+0.3)];
      const building=api.place({assetId:aid,name:isPublic?"组团公共场所":"依坡石屋",position:[q.x,0.18,q.z],terrain:true,facing:{target:[p.x,p.z]},groupId});
      api.foundation({name:"贴合山地石砌基座",shape:"rounded-rectangle",under:[building],margin:0.18,top:"level",thickness:0.18,maxThickness:1.5,material:"rough mountain stone"});
      walk([[p.x,p.z],entrance],"入户步道与高差过渡",1.65);
      api.place({assetId:step,position:[entrance[0],0.06,entrance[1]],terrain:true,facing:{target:[q.x,q.z]},scale:[0.75,1,1],groupId});
      const right=[uz,-ux];
      for(let k=0;k<2;k++){
        const side=k===0?-1:1;
        const x=q.x+ux*0.55+right[0]*side*2.1;
        const z=q.z+uz*0.55+right[1]*side*2.1;
        if(isPublic){
          api.place({assetId:bench,position:[x,z],facing:{target:[p.x,p.z]},groupId});
        } else if(k===0){
          api.place({assetId:wood,position:[q.x-ux*0.7+right[0]*3.15,q.z-uz*0.7+right[1]*3.15],facing:{target:[p.x,p.z]},groupId});
        }
      }
      api.environmentSample(entrance);
      api.environmentSample([q.x,q.z]);
    }
  }
  const root=nodes[best.i];
  let exit=-1,exitScore=1000000;
  for(let i=0;i<nodes.length;i++){
    const p=nodes[i];
    if(p.ix===0||p.ix===8||p.iz===0||p.iz===8){

}

function plan(api) {
  api.sceneIntent({kind:"authored",reason:"保留雪山基底，以实测坡度、入口高差和步行距离选择石屋村落组团与路网。"});
  const orient = " Coordinate contract: Y+ is up, Z+ is the front/entrance/forward direction, X+ is right; place doors, facades, openings, windshields, or noses toward local Z+ and keep the model centered at its origin.";
  function sample(p) {
    return api.environmentSample(p);
  }
  function distance(a,b) {
    const dx=a[0]-b[0], dz=a[1]-b[1];
    return Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dz*dz);
  }
  function asset(key,name,prompt,dimensions,extra) {
    const spec={key:key,name:name,prompt:prompt+orient,dimensions:dimensions,role:"structure"};
    if (extra) spec.light=extra;
    api.requireAsset(spec);
    return api.asset(key,0);
  }
  function footprint(p,w,d) {
    const mid=sample(p);
    let lo=mid.height, hi=mid.height, slope=0;
    for (const dx of [-w/2,0,w/2]) {
      for (const dz of [-d/2,0,d/2]) {
        const s=sample([p[0]+dx,p[1]+dz]);
        lo=Math.min(lo,s.height);
        hi=Math.max(hi,s.height);
        slope+=Math.abs(s.slope);
      }
    }
    return {height:mid.height,relief:hi-lo,slope:slope/9};
  }
  // 两种拓扑同时检查：南、东入口的公共中心辐射网；西、北入口的串联村巷。
  const alternatives=[
    {centers:[[-24,-20],[23,-14],[0,23]],edges:[[0,1],[0,2]],entries:[{p:[-35,-44],to:0},{p:[44,-4],to:1}]},
    {centers:[[-25,16],[20,23],[3,-23]],edges:[[0,1],[1,2]],entries:[{p:[-44,27],to:0},{p:[29,44],to:1}]}
  ];
  const offsets=[[-12,0],[12,0],[0,12],[0,-12]];
  function cluster(center) {
    const plaza=footprint(center,11,11);
    const buildings=[];
    let cost=plaza.relief*9+plaza.slope*0.15;
    for (let j=0;j<offsets.length;j++) {
      const off=offsets[j];
      let best=null;
      // 沿同一入口方向微调选址，避免任意旋转造成门口与路不相接。
      for (const shift of [-2,0,2]) {
        const p=[center[0]+off[0]+(off[0]===0?shift:0),center[1]+off[1]+(off[1]===0?shift:0)];
        const f=footprint(p,7,7);
        const delta=Math.abs(f.height-plaza.height);
        const score=f.relief*7+f.slope*0.12+delta*5+Math.max(0,delta-1.6)*30;
        if (!best || score<best.cost) best={p:p,height:f.height,cost:score,relief:f.relief};
      }
      buildings.push(best);
      cost+=best.cost;
    }
    return {center:center,height:plaza.height,buildings:buildings,cost:cost};
  }
  function gateway(center,target) {
    const sx=target[0]>=center[0]?1:-1;
    const sz=target[1]>=center[1]?1:-1;
    return [center[0]+sx*8,center[1]+sz*8];
  }
  function makeConnection(a,b,aCluster,bCluster) {
    const points=[a];
    if (aCluster) points.push(gateway(a,b));
    if (bCluster) points.push(gateway(b,a));
    points.push(b);
    return points;
  }
  function roadCost(points,groups) {
    let result=0;
    for (let i=0;i<points.length-1;i++) {
      const a=points[i], b=points[i+1], length=distance(a,b);
      const sa=sample(a), sb=sample(b);
      const grade=Math.abs(sa.height-sb.height)/Math.max(1,length);
      result+=length*0.2+Math.max(0,grade-0.16)*length*35;
      for (let k=0;k<=8;k++) {
        const t=k/8;
        const p=[a[0]+(b[0]-a[0])*t,a[1]+(b[1]-a[1])*t];
        const s=sample(p);
        const target=sa.height+(sb.height-sa.height)*t;
        result+=Math.abs(s.height-target)*2+Math.abs(s.slope)*0.05;
        for (const g of groups) {
          for (const house of g.buildings) {
            if (distance(p,house.p)<5.4) result+=150;
          }
        }
      }
    }
    return result;
  }
  let chosen=null;
  for (const candidate of alternatives) {
    const groups=[];
    let score=0;
    for (const c of candidate.centers) {
      const g=cluster(c);
      groups.push(g);

    }
    const roads=[];
    for (const edge of candidate.edges) {
      roads.push(makeConnection(candidate.centers[edge[0]],candidate.centers[edge[1]],true,true));
    }
    for (const entry of candidate.entries) {
      roads.push(makeConnection(entry.p,candidate.centers[entry.to],false,true));
    }
    for (const road of roads) score+=roadCost(road,groups);
    candidate.groups=groups;
    candidate.roads=roads;
    candidate.score=score;
    if (!chosen || score<chosen.score) chosen=candidate;
  }
